title: Recording, mixing: Oriental Nightfish by Linda McCartney | 1977
content:
AIR Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

Paul and Linda McCartney worked on Linda’s song ‘Oriental Nightfish’ on 6 December 1977.

The song had been started on 4 Octonber 1973 during the Band On The Run sessions, but was left unfinished. It was revived on this day for possible inclusion in the soundtrack of an animated film directed by Ian Emes.

Paul McCartney transferred the song onto 24-track tape, after which he overdubbed some sound effects required by Emes, and created a stereo mix.
